import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_9.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_5/training_10.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (UNION)
Target9_5 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the schema and types match the target schema
Target9_5 = Target9_5.astype({'code': 'int64', 'name': 'string'})

# Write the final target table to the specified path
Target9_5.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_5/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
